description: This file defines the React component 'MultiverseExplorerView' which provides the user interface for exploring multiverse paths, role recommendations, and mindmap visualization related to career navigation. It handles data fetching, filtering, bookmarking, and user interactions within a complex multi-step exploration process.

methods.name: normalizeBackendBookmarksToLocal
methods.description: Converts backend bookmark records to local bookmark objects, sorting by creation date.

methods.name: normalizeRecommendedRoles
methods.description: Extracts and normalizes role recommendation data from backend response.

methods.name: roleIdFromRec
methods.description: Generates a role ID string from a recommendation object, with fallback for missing data.

methods.name: roleTitleFromRec
methods.description: Extracts the role title from a recommendation object.

methods.name: labelForPathType
methods.description: Converts a multiverse path type to a user-friendly label.

methods.name: describePathType
methods.description: Provides a textual description for a given path type.

methods.name: looksLikePathType
methods.description: Type guard function to check if a string is a valid multiverse path type.

methods.name: pathMatchesFilters
methods.description: Filters a career path based on search query, industry, and skills.
